description: This source file provides utility functions for health checking in a Kubernetes environment. It includes functions for logging setup, fetching and building Kubernetes clients from kubeconfig stored in Vault, listing nodes and pods, executing commands inside containers, collecting system metrics, performing network connectivity checks, and assembling structured health reports. It also features functions for sending reports via Kafka and Loki. The code is modular with clearly defined public interface functions and employs external libraries such as requests, kubernetes, confluent_kafka, and internal utilities for logging.
